Name: Sir Robert's Flower Power
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[u][color=#efefef][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#efefef][size=4]This mod features delightful and charming sunflowers, peonies, poppies and gerbera daisies to decorate your home in Stardew Valley. I like to have lots of options, so you will find each image has an assortment of glass vases, pretty polka-dotted vases or colorful pots to choose from. [/size][/color]

[color=#efefef][size=4]Truthfully, I attempted to recreate a purple zinnia and a burgundy dahlia, but I don't know if I accomplished that or not - it's dang difficult to put in a lot of detail when it comes to tiny pixel art.[/size][/color]

[color=#efefef][size=4]That being said, I'm delighted with the way this one turned out! Hopefully the flowers are recognizable and I feel they still retain the stylistic charm that is fitting for Stardew Valley. Not to mention, they give you lots of decorating options - especially if you mix and match these with flowers and plants from my other mods![/size][/color]

[u][color=#efefef][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#efefef][size=4]Install the latest version of SMAPI. Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods. When you play the game, the images will be found in the Decor/Houseplant section of the furniture catalog or Happy Home Designer.[/size][/color]

[u][color=#efefef][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#efefef][size=4]Images #1 through #10 consists of flowers that can be placed upon [u]end tables[/u]. Some flowers only have a few options and others will have more.[/size][/color]

[color=#efefef][size=4]Image #11 consists of flowers that look best upon countertops and square cocktail tables. You will notice that there are two of each image - one is moved upward a few pixels to fit better on [u]countertops[/u] and the other is moved down to align correctly on [u]square cocktail tables[/u]. [/size][/color]

[u][color=#efefef][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#efefef][size=4]Requires the Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. I also recommend using Happy Home Designer.[/size][/color]

[u][color=#efefef][size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#efefef][size=4]The end tables in the pictures are by Platinum Cats, Orangeblossom7 and stardust. I also used end tables from the actual game. The countertops are from PC's Shabby Chic Kitchen by Platinum Cats and Lovely Kitchen Islands and Extras (AT) by lululovely.[/size][/color]
